artworks.title: John Boydell
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of John Boydell. He is seated, facing forward with a neutral expression. Boydell has distinct facial features, white powdered wig, 18th-century attire, and holds a paper in his left hand. A book or document is on the table next to him, with a stack of books visible behind him. The background is a plain wall with shadows.

artworks.title: Ripon Cathedral from the Southeast, adjacent to the River Skell
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a rural setting with a courtyard, a stone building, and a small pool of water. There is a man with a cart and a woman sitting on the stone edge near the water. In the distance, a grand stone cathedral is visible. The view is framed by rustic buildings and walls made of brick and stone. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving the photograph a historical feel. The composition provides a glimpse into daily life with the cathedral dominating the distant view.

artworks.title: Les Cigognes (The Storks)
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of storks near a wall structure. The drawing features two storks standing in close proximity to a large, imposing stone wall. The two birds are illustrated with a high level of detail. The stone wall features rounded columns and a circular window or decorative element on it. The setting appears to be by a riverbank or a similar natural environment, as indicated by the varying textures representing water and ground beneath the birds. In the background, the sky is depicted with some clouds.

artworks.title: La Ferme de Brieux (Effect d'orage) (Farm at Brieux in a Storm)
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a rural landscape with buildings, trees, and open fields in the distant horizon. The scene is characterized by heavy cross-hatching and linear strokes, creating detailed textures and shadowing. The monochromatic palette of black and white emphasizes the contrast between light and dark, adding depth to the image. Close to us, there is an earth pathway, and further back are buildings, trees, and a swirling sky dominating the upper portion of the composition.

artworks.title: Baron Brudern
artworks.medium: engraving and etching printed in color on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up, in profile facing slightly to the right. He has distinct facial features with a straight nose, defined lips, and light-colored eyes. His hair is short, curly, and brown. He is wearing a dark navy blue coat with a high, white, ruffled collar and intricate button detailing. Over one shoulder, he has a fur stole secured with a leaf-shaped clasp and golden tassels. The background has a textured backdrop.

artworks.title: Cain and Abel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a dynamic and tense interaction. The image depicts a scene with two figures who appear to be in a conflict or struggle. The figure in the foreground is crouched down, with one arm and one leg supporting their weight, while the other arm is extended forward. The second figure is elevated, poised above the first figure, holding a large stick or club above their head with both hands. The interaction between the two figures is charged with energy and motion, enhanced by strong, etched lines and the use of shading to create depth and texture. The background is relatively plain, with some light shading and sparse line work, drawing attention to the central action of the figures.

artworks.title: Druidesse
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a profile view, with their face turned to the left. They have a straight nose, a closed mouth, and long hair hidden under a dark veil. The person wears a headpiece and soft, layered clothing. The background is dark, creating a contrast with the person who is highlighted with lighter shading.

artworks.title: Allegory of Spring
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and shapes that form an abstract impression of movement. In the center, there is a figure resembling a human body entangled with smaller shapes resembling heads, arms, and torsos. This central figure stands on an incomplete background of straight and curved lines, distorting the human form into an abstract composition. The elements create a dynamic representation utilizing human anatomy but in a surreal manner.

artworks.title: La Dernière Maja
artworks.medium: drypoint with etching and aquatint on light blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure surrounded by abstract and fantastical elements. The central focus is a person seated with their back turned, clothed in drapery, positioned before a circular object. The drawing includes surreal elements like serpentine forms and mythical creatures with tails and wings. In each corner, creatures with imaginative designs are depicted, such as merman-like figures with human and fish-like qualities. The upper left of the drawing includes French text. The creatures interact with the surroundings and each other, creating a curious interplay between imaginative realism and myth. The drawing explores the mystical aspects of the human imagination.

artworks.title: Emigrants
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures on a ship's deck. The central figure faces the viewer, with distinct facial features and short dark hair under a hat. They wear a dark cloak. Another figure, partially obscured, extends an arm towards the central figure. The intricate rigging of the ship surrounds them, with masts, ropes, and sails against a cloudy sky. The ship's architectural details and a busy port environment are depicted.

artworks.title: Herbst
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures walking across a field carrying large baskets and bundles. The image is rendered in monochrome, utilizing details and shading to provide texture and depth. The figures are heavily laden with baskets full of sticks on their backs. They traverse a grassy landscape, with trees lining the horizon in the distance under a sky with clouds. The artistry captures movement and struggle, with detail in the grass and baskets, creating a scene that suggests toil and labor.

artworks.title: A Strong Breeze, Flying Clouds
artworks.description: This photograph features a view of dark water under a cloudy sky, with a horizon in the bottom third dividing the sea and the sky. On the horizon, the shapes of distant buildings or rocks are visible, including one tall shape that could be a lighthouse. The sea is almost completely black, except for a few small white ripples in the bottom of the photograph. The sky is light gray and filled with puffy white clouds.

artworks.title: Reflections
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the shoulders up. They are in a relaxed position, with their head resting on their hand. Their facial features are soft and expressive, with gently closed lips and slightly downcast eyes. The person has curly and voluminous hair framing their face. The clothing is simple, and there are no visible accessories or objects. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Tree with Tangle of Roots
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of tree roots intertwined with rocks and earth. The horizon is not visible in the focused composition, which highlights the pattern created by the roots and stones. The photograph has a realistic style with fine details, capturing the texture of the tree bark and rocky surface. The color palette is primarily sepia-toned, enhancing the aged effect and natural feel. In the foreground, a patch of ground is covered with roots and rocks, leading to large tree trunks emerging from the soil.

artworks.title: Untitled (Double exposure of several people in interior)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of five individuals, with most of their bodies visible. Two women are seated in the foreground, both wearing voluminous dresses with puffed sleeves. One of these women has short, styled hair visible, and her facial features are slightly blurred. A piece of fabric is draped over her face. Behind them, three men are standing; they wear dark suits with high, white collars. Another woman stands to the left, partially obscured by holding a sheer, white fabric over her face, her hair styled into an upward bun. Above all of them is an ethereal figure in a similar white dress that appears to be floating. The background includes patterned wallpaper and a table with a vase, along with some indistinct decorations suggestive of a domestic setting. The photograph has a blue tint or cyanotype appearance.

artworks.title: Untitled (Fishbowl)
artworks.description: The image shows a round fishbowl filled with water and several small fish inside, placed on a woven wicker table. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving the photo a vintage appearance with shades of brown and beige. In the foreground, the fishbowl sits centrally atop the table, while the blurred background suggests an outdoor setting with a soft, uniform texture.

artworks.title: Still Life of Musical Instruments
artworks.description: The image features a variety of musical instruments, including a large curved horn at the center top, drums such as the tabla and dholak, and a xylophone at the bottom. The color palette consists of sepia and brown tones, creating a vintage feel. Smaller instruments like bells and cymbals are hanging on the wall near the horn, while the drums and xylophone are placed on a wooden surface.

artworks.title: A Young Woman Standing in a Park
artworks.artist: Gilles-Antoine Demarteau after Jean-Baptiste Le Prince
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red and black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing from the waist up. She is turned slightly to the side with her head tilted upwards, looking straight ahead. She has a pleasant expression with slightly parted lips and styled hair adorned with a flower or decorative piece. She wears an elegant, long dress with puffy sleeves, a high neckline, and a ruffled collar. The dress has a fitted bodice with a sash at the waist. She is holding a potted plant with blooming flowers. The background includes a stone balustrade and foliage, suggesting an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: The Acropolis of Athens, plate 21
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an ancient architectural ruin. The image captures a large, intricately detailed stone doorway leading into the interior space of a ruinous ancient structure. The doorway is framed by stone pillars and a lintel decorated with floral motifs. Beyond the doorway, fragmented stone blocks and rubble can be seen. The lighting suggests that the photograph was taken when the sun was low, casting long shadows and highlighting the texture of the stone. In the forefront, there is a fluted column drum resting on the ground. The photograph conveys a sense of history and the passage of time through its focus on the weathered stonework and decaying structure.

artworks.title: The Acropolis of Athens, plate 20
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins with a structure featuring classical columns with fluted shafts and Ionic capitals. The perspective is at ground level, allowing a direct view of the entrance. Debris and fallen stones are scattered nearby. The sky above is clear. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia, emphasizing the age and texture of the stone. The lighting casts shadows and highlights that accentuate the architectural forms and details of the columns.

artworks.title: The Acropolis of Athens, plate 14
artworks.description: The image shows the ruins of an ancient temple, taken from a low vantage point. The horizon is at the top with a view of the landscape through a doorway. Remnants of columns and stones are scattered nearby. The photo is monochromatic, with a sepia tone. The texture of the stone is detailed, showing wear and tear over time. Shadows from the ruins create depth, highlighting the grandeur and decay of the architecture against a blurred sky.

artworks.title: Propylaea from the Southwest
artworks.description: The photograph shows a close-up view of ancient ruins. The camera is situated below the structure, looking slightly upward. The horizon is not visible. The image is filled with ancient ruins and rocks, including an ancient stone building partially in ruin, with large columns and intricately carved stonework. Stairs lead up to the building, with various steps appearing uneven due to wear and scattered debris. The image has a monochromatic color palette in various shades of sepia. The surface texture of the stone is detailed, enhancing the rugged and weathered appearance of the scene.

artworks.title: Réservoir de Montrouge, basin supérieur, côté droit (Montrouge Reservoir, Upper Basin, Right Side)
artworks.description: The image shows a construction site from above. In the distance, there are tall structures including two towers and a smokestack. The foreground features a stone wall and wooden walkways with workers engaged in construction activities. In the middle ground, more workers are visible working on masonry. The photo is in black and white, highlighting the textures of the materials used.

artworks.title: Arcades de pont sur Vanne (Arcades, Bridge over the Vanne)
